title: Cathode-supported solid polymer electrolyte with solvate ionic liquid and polysulfide modification for rechargeable lithium metal batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01381F, Paper
Yan Yuan, Yaxin Kong, Xiuping Peng, Lei Zhang, Zeyu Li, Hai Lu
A cathode-supported solid polymer electrolyte was fabricated for rechargeable lithium metal batteries, modified synergistically with a solvate ionic liquid (SIL) as a plasticizer and a soluble polysulfide (Li2S6) as a functional additive.
